shots.line: Under the northern lights, sixty-six startups stand across Helsinki. Eight of them are hiring tonight.
At Töölönlahdenkatu 2, Verda runs data centres and GPU hardware for training AI models, backed by a 189 million dollar Series B.
Over on Lapinlahdenkatu 16, Saidot builds an AI governance platform that maps models, risks, and compliance policies.
At Pursimiehenkatu 29, University of Helsinki spin-off Aiforia Technologies provides cloud software for medical image analysis.
Down at Henry Fordin katu 6, 126 people at ReOrbit build sovereign satellites and software for national security.
From business software to space hardware, the city works through the night. Choose an address below to explore.
